bash -lc python3 - <<'PY'
# VA 0x4a988c etc: which section? .text is 0x401000-0x489079, .rodata 0x48d000+0x41641 => 0x48d000-0x4ce641. So 0x4a... is in .rodata. file off = VA - 0x48d000 + 0x8d000
def va_to_off(va):
    return va - 0x48d000 + 0x8d000
targets = {
    "username?": (0x4a988c, 0x8),
    "password?": (0x4a9894, 0x8),
    "usage1": (0x4aa6c6, 0xe),
    "usage2": (0x4aa6d4, 0x14 if False else 0xe),
    "expected_pass": (0x4aa99e, 0xf),
    "filename?": (0x4aa9ad, 0xf),
    "content1": (0x4b1603, 0x45),
    "content2": (0x4ab8f1, 0x14),
    "go_str_594": (0x4a988c, 0x30),
}
with open('/app/admin-tool','rb') as f:
    for name,(va,length) in targets.items():
        off = va_to_off(va)
        f.seek(off)
        data = f.read(length+32)
        print(f"{name} VA={hex(va)} off={hex(off)} len={length}:")
        print(f"  raw[{length}]: {data[:length]!r}")
        try:
            print(f"  as text: {data[:length].decode()!r}")
        except: pass
        print(f"  extended: {data!r}")
        print()
PY
